title: val in Constructors
instructions: In `class Motor(val name: String)`, what does `val` mean for the `name` property?

options.text: The name can be changed later
The name is read-only after the object is created
The name must be a String

explanation: Using `val` in a constructor makes the property read-only. Once the object is created, you cannot change its `name`. If you used `var` instead, the property would be mutable and you could change it later.
